entries.name: returnables-first-issue-key-lock
entries.claim: Two first Issues of different custody records for one company, party, type, direction and currency serialize on the custody key's transaction lock.
entries.original:
await client.query(
          `SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
             $1::text || ':' || $2::text || ':' || $3::text || ':' || $4::text
             || ':' || $5::text || ':' || $6::text || ':' || $7::text || ':' || $8::text, 0))`,
          [
            ...scope,
            RETURNABLES_CAPABILITY_ID,
            le,
            partyId,
            String(custodyValue('asset_type_id')),
            direction,
            currency,
          ],
        );
